about: Douglas A. Yeager is an attorney who represents clients in the Houston, Texas area. Douglas Yeager is recognized by peers and was selected to Super Lawyers for 2004, 2011 - 2013, 2018 - 2026. This selection is based off of an evaluation of 12 indicators including peer recognition and professional achievement in legal practice.

Douglas Yeager chose to pursue a career in law after completing undergraduate studies. He attended Southern Methodist University Dedman School of Law and graduated in 1993. Douglas Yeager passed the bar exam and was admitted to legal practice in 1993.
He represents clients with Real Estate: Business issues in Texas. He also represents clients with Banking issues.

Being selected to Super Lawyers is limited to a small number of attorneys in each state. As one of the few attorneys to garner the distinction of Super Lawyers, Douglas Yeager has earned the respect of peers as one of the top-rated attorneys in the nation.

The Super Lawyers patented selection process is peer influenced and research driven, selecting the top 5% of attorneys to the Super Lawyers lists each year. We know lawyers and make it easy to connect with them.
